breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous constraint that end slopes are zero under symmetric loading. Instead, it applies the proper simply supported boundary conditions (y(0)=0, y(L)=0, y''(0)=0, y''(L)=0) and explicitly instructs computing the slope at x=0 as θ(0)=y'(0) from the solved expression — implying it is a non-zero value to be determined, not forced to zero. This aligns with the ground truth, which makes no mention of zero end slopes.
